evidenceCaveat: Exactly 315 original teacher goals and activity structures read and compared against corresponding original student-pack lesson purpose words in one 500-manifest. The other 185 have separate prior source-purpose reviews. The screen assesses presence of mathematical concepts and detects contradictory reusable template rules; it DOES NOT judge correctness of every worked problem, independent full original activity fidelity, effective materialization, visual mathematics, rights, eight dimensions, L1-L6, or UI browser behavior. A cue match is not a PASS.
